doc: Golden vectors for the MMZO v1 zone-order block (docs/reference/mm9pdy-zones-format.md, Zone order). Synthetic demo data only. zones: each zone's slots in zone order (the table's bitmap is the same set). skipped: as in mmzs-v1.json, member indices in slot order left out of the scan set, or null. sets_kinds, sets_length: the MMZS block written first. kinds, fallback: the order block's zone kinds and the zones whose order did not fit (visited in slot order). entries: per zone, null (kind 0) or entry j = the slot-order index of the zone's j-th member. offset: the block's stream offset, null when MMZS leaves no room (no block is written). block_hex: stream bytes offset to offset + 22 + L - 1. frames: every 64-byte clone W frame in write order, the MMZ1 table's, then the stream's (MMZS and MMZO together). Rejects: the sector is the MMZ1 table of zones (encoded with no sets) with the 576-byte stream_hex in place; a reader visits every zone in slot order (reason is a word of the reference codec's reason) and still loads the table.

mixed.doc: ALPHA (8 members, 3 bits each) and ECHO (5 members, 3 bits) out of slot order, DELTA two members reversed (1 bit each); BRAVO already in slot order and CHARLIE of one member are kind 0. No scan sets: MMZS L = 0, the block at offset 32. 24 + 2 + 15 = 41 entry bits, L = 6

all_slot_order.doc: Every zone in slot order: the block is still written, kind 0 throughout, L = 0

empty.doc: No zones: MMZS and MMZO blocks with N = 0, L = 0

after_sets.doc: mmzs-v1.json's two_kind1 scan sets (MMZS L = 4, 26 bytes) with CHARLIE and DELTA ordered: the block at offset 32, after 6 FF bytes

cross_c380.doc: MMZS skips a quarter of a 999-member zone (999 bits, L = 125, ends at 147), so the order block starts at offset 160; BACK's 300 entries of 9 bits (L = 338) take it to offset 519, through 0xC380

exactly_522.doc: One zone of 464 members reversed: 4,176 entry bits, L = 522, the largest block; it starts at offset 32 and ends at 575, through 0xC380

fallback.doc: Scan sets first: four zones skip a member each (3,996 bits, MMZS L = 500), leaving the order block at offset 528 with 26 data bytes (208 bits). BIG (100 x 7 bits) falls back to slot order; SMALL (20 x 5) fits; MID (30 x 5), tried after, no longer fits and falls back

no_room.doc: mmzs-v1.json's exactly_4432 with F5 reversed: MMZS fills the stream (L = 554), no order block is written and F5 falls back; the frames are exactly_4432's

stale_generation.doc: mixed's order block left behind a fresh MMZS block after the table was rewritten (one BRAVO member moved, same member count)

bad_crc.doc: mixed with the order block CRC's low bit flipped

not_permutation.doc: mixed with ALPHA's first two entries both 0, CRC recomputed

kind_2.doc: mixed with BRAVO's kind set to 2 (reserved), CRC recomputed

kind_3.doc: mixed with BRAVO's kind set to 3 (reserved), CRC recomputed

kind1_one_member.doc: mixed with CHARLIE (one member) marked kind 1, CRC recomputed

pad_bits.doc: mixed with bit 7 of the last data byte set (41 bits: bits 1-7 are pad), CRC recomputed

wrong_length.doc: mixed with L = 7 and a 00 byte appended (41 bits need 6 bytes), CRC recomputed

length_over_room.doc: mixed with L = 523, one more than the 522 data bytes after offset 32 (the stream ends at 575), CRC left as is: a reader stops before any data read

kind_past_n.doc: mixed with zone 5's kind set to 1 (N = 5, zones 0-4), CRC recomputed

n_mismatch.doc: mixed with the order block's N = 4 (the table has 5), CRC recomputed

sets_invalid.doc: mixed with the MMZS block's CRC broken and the order block intact: no scan sets, so no order

no_block.doc: mixed's table and MMZS block as a writer without zone order leaves them: no order block
